annotations.title: Get menu and price per person

description: What a UAE restaurant serves and what it costs: dishes with AED prices (from the merchant's menu on Talabat, or dine-in menu photos on Zomato read by a vision model), price per person worked out from menu prices, Zomato's own cost for two, and how much higher or lower Talabat delivery prices are than dine-in. Use the business id from discond_find_venues, discond_find_discounts or discond_autocomplete_businesses. Prices may have changed; service charge and delivery fees are not included.
